title: Dataq Quanta — Overview
meta_description: Emerging compute with investor discipline — baselines, benchmarks, verdicts.

blocks.x: How Dataq Quanta — Overview runs when it is engineered for the enterprise: bounded scope per gate, platform evidence generated in-flight, and outcomes stated as deltas against the number we signed together.

Dataq Quanta runs our quantum and advanced-compute programs: readiness assessments with HNDL risk clocks, solver tournaments (classical vs. Quantum-inspired vs. Hybrid) on your actual formulations, PQC migration with CBOM-grade discovery, HPC engineering, and the emerging-silicon watchlist.

blocks.title: Dataq Quanta — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: Under the hood this pattern runs on one rule: cost and quality telemetry land in the same view your owners read across the Dataq Quanta estate, so your control owners can interrogate any number we publish.

blocks.x: At operating tempo, the properties that carry the load are structural: identity is short-lived and authorization is deny-by-default for the enterprise at scale, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

Quanta's discipline is economic: every initiative carries a classical baseline it must beat on identical benchmarks; negative results are documented deliverables. Where solvers win, we industrialize them as services with re-solve SLAs; where they don't, you keep an improved baseline and a revisit trigger.
